content.comment_body: I'm experiencing issues connecting my new [product_name] controller to my PC for uploading and downloading programs. I've had no problems with older [product_name] devices, but I recently purchased this [article_no], which is my first with a display, and I'm unable to establish a connection. My PC is configured with: IP 192.168.0.100, subnet mask 255.255.255.0, gateway 192.168.0.8. The [article_no] is set to: IP 192.168.0.8, subnet 255.255.255.0, gateway 192.168.0.100. In the network view, the [product_name] icon shows a green tick when online. When I attempt to transfer the program, the interface window opens, I can press the test button, and a green line and tick appear between the PC and the device. The target IP address is 192.168.0.8. The accessible device window displays IP: 192.168.0.8, subnet mask: 255.255.255.0, gateway: 192.168.0.100, MAC address: e0-dc-a0-10-b3-05, status: yes—all highlighted blue. When I press OK, I briefly see the "connecting to bm" message, then nothing happens: the program doesn't load and there are no error messages. The only error appears if I try to upload from the device to the PC, even though it has no program. In that case, I get a message: 'The configured device in the project will be replaced because its device type is different from that of the connected device. Do you want to continue?' Upon clicking yes, nothing changes. Does anyone have advice on what I might be doing wrong?

Are you using the latest version of [product_name] programming software ([product_name] V8.1)? If your hardware is the [version_no] FS04 version, it requires V8.1 (make sure you select the correct device in the software). You can find a free upgrade at [url].

First: If you have a [product_name] FS04, you need [product_name] V8.1 to properly select the hardware, as older software versions won't work. Second: If you've set the PC's gateway address to 192.168.0.8, then the device should not have the same IP address and a gateway address of 192.168.0.100; this causes issues. When directly connecting the device to the PC, set the gateway address correctly on the device.

It's incorrect to enter the other device's IP address as the gateway. The gateway usually is the router's IP, or you can leave it blank if no router is present or needed. Here, since both devices are on the same local network, no gateway is necessary.

analysis.insight_summary: A user is unable to connect a newly acquired [product_name] controller ([article_no] with display) to a PC for uploading and downloading program data, despite success with previous models. Responses identify possible issues: using an incompatible software version (correct version required for certain hardware), and incorrect network configuration, specifically with the gateway settings, leading to failure during program transfer and a lack of informative error messages. Overall, users are prompted to ensure the right software version is selected and that proper network parameters are set for successful device communication.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects a simple setup that allows easy PC-to-device program transfers, clear feedback if operations fail, and programming software that supports current hardware without compatibility issues or complicated configuration.
